as_told.title: Nazi Bell test ring in Poland possibly testing the Magenta craft

plain: A craft the tellers call the Magenta craft is said to have been taken to Nazi Germany, where it was studied. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas tells Michels it is reasonable to think the craft went there for study, without naming a source. Michels, on an episode with a Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, frames it as a question: he describes pictures of sites in Czechoslovakia and Poland and a ring-shaped test structure into which something shaped like an acorn or a bell could fit, and asks whether that was where the Magenta craft was tested. If true, it would mean the Nazis had a non-human craft to learn from.
